promotion_rule: Zero speed regression: a candidate replaces BEST_VALIDATED only if peak memory is lower AND paired same-session A/B wall time is not slower (median diff <= 0, CI upper bound not clearly > 0), then full2 + check_rules 10/10. Memory-only wins stay in BEST_MEMORY_EXPERIMENT. Target peak 2.3-2.8 GiB, runtime <= 71.0 s (preferred < 68 s).
